# Tally API Audit Log

CRUD audit of TallyPrime's XML HTTP interface (Create, Alter, Fetch, Delete), run against TallyPrime in
Educational Mode on a VMware VM.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Tally URL | `http://192.168.71.130:9000` |
| Mode | Educational (dates limited to the 1st, 2nd and 31st of a month) |
| Client | `tally_audit/tally_audit.py` |
| Reference | `docs/TallyPrime_API_Explorer_Reference.md` |

**Order:** Groups → Ledgers → Units (simple, compound) → Stock Groups → Stock Items → Accounting Vouchers
(Receipt, Payment, Sales, Purchase).

**Per entry:** request sent, response received, the verify fetch that followed, which sent fields did not
persist, and a status of Success / Failed / Tally Crashed. A health check (company-name pull) runs after
every request; a failed one halts the run.

---

## Pre-check: Fetch Group - ZZ Audit Primary (does not exist yet)

- **Time:** 2026-10-09 11:17:17
- **Status:** Success
- **Tally result:** test group name is free

**Request Sent:**

```xml
<ENVELOPE>
    <HEADER>
        <VERSION>1</VERSION>
        <TALLYREQUEST>Export</TALLYREQUEST>
        <TYPE>Object</TYPE>
        <SUBTYPE>Group</SUBTYPE>
        <ID TYPE="Name">ZZ Audit Primary</ID>
    </HEADER>
    <BODY>
        <DESC>
            <STATICVARIABLES>
                <SVEXPORTFORMAT>XML</SVEXPORTFORMAT>
                <SVCURRENTCOMPANY>Bhrama Enterprises</SVCURRENTCOMPANY>
            </STATICVARIABLES>
        </DESC>
    </BODY>
</ENVELOPE>
```

**Response Received:**

```xml
<ERRORMSG>Could not find Group:ZZ Audit Primary!</ERRORMSG>
```

**Verification Result:**

Read-only pre-check. A missing object comes back as a bare `<ERRORMSG>` element with no `<ENVELOPE>`, HTTP 200. Health check passed afterwards.

## Pre-check: Fetch Group - Sundry Debtors (Object export, no FETCHLIST)

- **Time:** 2026-10-09 11:17:17
- **Status:** Tally Crashed
- **Tally result:** RemoteDisconnected: Remote end closed connection without response

**Request Sent:**

```xml
<ENVELOPE>
    <HEADER>
        <VERSION>1</VERSION>
        <TALLYREQUEST>Export</TALLYREQUEST>
        <TYPE>Object</TYPE>
        <SUBTYPE>Group</SUBTYPE>
        <ID TYPE="Name">Sundry Debtors</ID>
    </HEADER>
    <BODY>
        <DESC>
            <STATICVARIABLES>
                <SVEXPORTFORMAT>XML</SVEXPORTFORMAT>
                <SVCURRENTCOMPANY>Bhrama Enterprises</SVCURRENTCOMPANY>
            </STATICVARIABLES>
        </DESC>
    </BODY>
</ENVELOPE>
```

**Response Received:**

```xml
(no response: RemoteDisconnected: Remote end closed connection without response)
```

**Verification Result:**

Read-only pre-check, nothing had been written to Tally. Tally accepted the request and closed the socket without sending any HTTP response. No further requests were sent.

**Confirmed on the VM (screenshot from the operator):** TallyPrime showed a modal `Error` dialog: `Internal Error. Contact Tally Solutions. Software Exception c0000005 (Memory Access Violation)`. This is a real Tally crash, first occurrence, triggered by a read-only request.

**Finding F-01:** an Object export (`<TYPE>Object</TYPE><SUBTYPE>Group</SUBTYPE>`) for an existing group with no `<FETCHLIST>` crashes TallyPrime with c0000005. The same request for a non-existent group is safe (returns `<ERRORMSG>`). Every later object fetch in this audit sends an explicit `<FETCHLIST>`.

**Also seen on the Gateway screen:** books period is 1-Apr-25 to 31-Mar-26, current date 1-Mar-2026, and the company is flagged `(e) Data exceptions exist` (pre-existing, not caused by this audit, which had written nothing).

## Step 1 Summary: Groups

24 logged operations (4 read-only checks, 5 creates, 5 alters, 3 pulls, 7 deletes). One read crashed Tally, two
writes exposed upsert behaviour, one rejected create left a ghost object; the rest persisted as sent or were
rejected cleanly. All six `ZZ Audit` test groups were deleted and each confirmed gone by a follow-up fetch.

| # | Finding | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| F-01 | **Object export without `<FETCHLIST>` crashes TallyPrime** (`c0000005 Memory Access Violation`) for an existing group. Safe for a missing group, safe with a fetch list. | Pre-check: Fetch Group - Sundry Debtors |
| F-02 | **`Action="Create"` on an existing name silently alters it** (`CREATED 0, ALTERED 1`, no error). The second create moved the group to another parent. | Create Group - ZZ Audit Debtors again |
| F-03 | **`Action="Alter"` on a missing name silently creates it** (`CREATED 1`). | Alter Group - ZZ Audit Missing |
| F-04 | **A rejected create leaves a ghost object.** Parent missing gives `EXCEPTIONS 1` + `LINEERROR`, but an Object fetch then returns the group (under `Primary`, `ALTERID 0`). It is absent from the Group collection and `Action="Delete"` removes it (`DELETED 1`). | Create / Delete Group - ZZ Audit Orphan |
| F-05 | **Nature flags are overridden by the parent.** Under `Sundry Debtors`, sent `ISREVENUE Yes` / `ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE No` came back `No` / `Yes`. Honoured only at primary level. Moving parent recomputes them. `ISBILLWISEON` is inherited too. | Create Group - ZZ Audit Debtors |
| F-06 | **Rename works through Alter**: `NAME` attribute = current name, `<NAME>` child = new name. MASTERID and GUID are kept; the old name stops resolving. | Alter Group - rename |
| F-07 | **Response shape differs from request shape.** Exports have no `<NAME>` child (name is the `NAME` attribute and `LANGUAGENAME.LIST`); a primary-level parent comes back as `&#4; Primary` (a control-character reference that breaks strict XML parsers); every field carries a `TYPE` attribute; `<CMPINFO>` contains `<GROUP>n</GROUP>` counters that collide with object tags. | every fetch |
| F-08 | **A missing object is a bare `<ERRORMSG>`** with HTTP 200 and no `<ENVELOPE>`. | Pre-check, delete verifications |
| F-09 | **"Pull All Groups" as documented returns almost no fields** (name and two empty balances, no `PARENT`). A TDL collection with `NATIVEMETHOD` is needed for anything useful. "Groups of Group" with `BELONGSTO Yes` includes the parent itself. | Pull All Groups, Pull Groups of Group |
| F-10 | **Error counters are inconsistent**: missing parent is `EXCEPTIONS 1`, undeletable or missing target is `ERRORS 1`; `<STATUS>` stays `1` in all of them. | Create Orphan, Delete entries |

Persisted exactly as sent: `PARENT`, `ISSUBLEDGER`, `ISADDABLE`, `ADDLALLOCTYPE`, and at primary level `ISREVENUE`,
`ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE`, `AFFECTSGROSSPROFIT`.

Environment notes: books period 1-Apr-25 to 31-Mar-26, so later steps use dates inside it (`20260301`, `20260302`,
`20260331`) rather than `20260401`. The company showed `(e) Data exceptions exist` before any write of this audit.

## Step 1 Validation Through the App (frontend localhost:3000, backend localhost:8000)

Group create / alter / delete were made through the running backend (`/ledgers/groups`, signed-in session), which
pushes each change to Tally as a JSON import (`try_push_group_realtime` in `backend/app/routers/sync.py`). After every
app call the group was fetched from Tally. Entries above titled `App: ...` hold the app request/response and the
Tally state. All test groups are gone from both sides (app back to 35 groups, Tally to 34).

| # | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| A-01 | **Rename duplicates the group in Tally.** App renamed `ZZ App Debtors` to `ZZ App Debtors Renamed`; Tally kept the old group (MASTERID 795) and got a new one (797). Deleting in the app then removed only the new one. Cause: the alter is sent under the new name only, and Tally creates on alter of an unknown name (F-03). | App: Alter Group - rename |
| A-02 | **App deletes locally even when Tally refuses.** With a child in Tally, the app answered `Group deleted successfully` twice while Tally kept `ZZ App Child` and `ZZ App Asset`. | App: Delete Group - ZZ App Child; final delete entry |
| A-03 | **Refused pushes are counted as synced.** After the two refused deletes the app's `/sync/health` showed `healthy`, 0 issues, and `synced_queue_count` had risen by one for every call, refused ones included. | final delete entry |
| A-04 | **The first create never reached Tally and nothing reported it.** App returned 200 for `ZZ App Asset`; Tally had no such group. The item stayed in the pending queue; health stayed `healthy`; the traffic log is empty. Replaying the identical JSON by hand succeeded, and later app pushes worked, so the cause is unknown (backend logs were not available to me). The pending row now points at a group the app has since deleted. | App: Create Group - ZZ App Asset; App replay |
| A-05 | **Nature is lost at primary level.** App group with nature `Asset` landed in Tally with `ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE No` (Liability). The form's `is_deemed_positive` is dropped by the backend schema and `nature` is never sent. | App: Create Group - ZZ App Asset |
| A-06 | **`used_for_calculation` and `method_to_allocate` are not applied.** Sent `Appropriate by Qty`; Tally shows `ADDLALLOCTYPE Not Applicable`. | App replay |
| A-07 | **Working as intended:** create under a parent, flag changes (`is_subledger`, `is_billwise_on`) and parent change all reached Tally correctly; the app blocks deleting a group that has a child in the app. | App: Create ZZ App Debtors / Child, Alter entries |
| A-08 | **`GET /sync/outbound-queue` fails** (request dies with no response to the browser), so the pending item cannot be inspected. Not investigated further. | observed during A-04 |
| A-09 | **Groups already imported from Tally are wrong in the app.** All 35 app groups have nature `Asset` and every flag false (Tally has 14 liability, 14 asset, 3 income, 3 expense groups); `Sundry Debtors` and `Sundry Creditors` have no parent in the app (Tally: `Current Assets`, `Current Liabilities`); the app has a group literally named ` Primary`, which is Tally's `&#4; Primary` parent marker stored as a real group (F-07). | Pull All Groups with fields vs `/ledgers/groups` |

## Step 1 Fixes and Recheck (backend group handling)

JSON experiments run first (entries titled `JSON experiment: ...`): a rename works when `metadata.name` is the
current name and `name` the new one; `basicgroupiscalculable` and `addlalloctype` are the keys Tally accepts;
refusals come back as `"status": "1"` with `errors` or `exceptions` set and no message text.

| # | Fix | Recheck through the app (entries titled `Recheck after fix: ...`) |
|---|---|---|
| A-01 | Rename addresses the name Tally still has (`build_group_json_payload(..., tally_name)`; old name kept on the queue row). | Fixed: old name absent, new name present with the same MASTERID 804. |
| A-02 | Delete is refused with HTTP 409 when Tally rejects it; the group stays in the app. | Fixed: 409, group still in app and Tally. After the blocking child was removed, all four deletes succeeded on both sides. |
| A-03 | `check_tally_json_success` now reads the counters (`tally_json_failure_reason`); the `"status": "1"` fallback is gone. Group pushes are written to the sync traffic log and the queue row. | Fixed: refused delete showed in `/sync/health` as `degraded`, 1 failed. |
| A-04 | Cause still unknown and not reproduced (all 11 pushes in the recheck reached Tally). A failed push is now recorded on the queue row and traffic log and returned to the caller as `tally_synced` / `tally_status` / `tally_message`. | Visible if it recurs; not root-caused. |
| A-05 | `is_revenue` / `is_deemed_positive` are derived from `nature` on create and update. | Fixed: primary `Asset` group landed with `ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE Yes`; primary `Expense` with `ISREVENUE Yes`, `ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE Yes`. |
| A-06 | Payload sends `basicgroupiscalculable` and `addlalloctype`. | Fixed: `Appropriate by Qty` and `BASICGROUPISCALCULABLE Yes` arrived; resetting to Not Applicable also arrived. |
| A-08 | `/sync/outbound-queue` used a non-existent `parent_id` attribute; now `parent_group_id`. Renames and deletes are built from the queue row's stored name. | Fixed: returns 200; it also retired the stale pending row left by A-04. |
| A-09 | Importer: `Primary` is treated as top level, not as a parent group; existing groups get their parent, flags and nature updated; `ALTERID` with Tally's leading space is parsed. Agent: group fetch list now includes the flags. | Fixed: after re-importing Tally's groups, all 34 match Tally on parent and six flags, 0 differences. |

Still open: the app keeps one group row named ` Primary` because the ledger importer files `Profit & Loss A/c`
under it (a ledger-import matter, for Step 2). F-02 (a create silently altering a Tally group the app does not
know) is not addressed.

## Group Delete: Blocker List and Cascade (follow-up to A-02)

`GET /ledgers/groups/{id}/delete-preview` lists every sub-group and ledger under a group at any depth, from
MyTally and from Tally (Tally's own `CanDelete` and `RESERVEDNAME` per object), in deletion order, with a reason
on anything that cannot be deleted. `DELETE /ledgers/groups/{id}?cascade=true` deletes them deepest first, Tally
before MyTally. The Groups page shows the list in a dialog and offers the cascade.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Plan for a nested tree (2 sub-groups, 3 ledgers, one sub-group and ledger existing only in Tally) | All 5 listed with correct parent, side (MyTally / Tally / both) and order |
| Plain delete with blockers | 409 `GROUP_HAS_BLOCKERS` with the plan; nothing deleted |
| Two ledgers used in a Tally voucher, then cascade | 409; both ledgers and the groups containing them marked with reasons; nothing deleted on either side |
| Voucher removed, cascade sent twice in parallel, then a third time | One `200` (6 objects deleted), one `409 DELETE_IN_PROGRESS`, then `404`. Exactly 6 Tally delete events and 4 queue rows, 0 pending |
| Same from the Groups page dialog, delete button clicked twice | Confirmation required before the button enables; one delete ran; group and ledger gone from MyTally and Tally |

## Step 2 Summary: Ledgers

Raw XML against Tally: 2 read-only fetches, 7 creates, 8 alters (three were sent twice after a script error of
mine; they are idempotent), 4 pulls, 8 deletes, plus nested-list reads. No crash. All seven `ZZ Audit` ledgers
were deleted and each confirmed gone.

| # | Finding | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| L-01 | **Sign of `OPENINGBALANCE`: negative is debit, unsigned is credit.** `-5000.00` on a debtor is Dr 5000; the Explorer's Alter sample (`30000` on a bank ledger) makes the bank Cr 30000. | Alter Ledger - ZZ Audit Bank (two entries) |
| L-02 | **An Object export returns nested lists empty.** `BillAllocations.List`, `LedMailingDetails.List`, `LedGSTRegDetails.List` come back as blank containers even when fetched by name. A collection with `<FETCH>...LIST</FETCH>` returns them filled. | Create Ledger - ZZ Audit Customer; Fetch nested lists |
| L-03 | **Bills are not reconciled with the opening balance.** Opening balance 7000 with bills totalling 4000 was accepted as is. | Create Ledger - ZZ Audit Supplier |
| L-04 | **Moving a ledger between groups does not touch its balance sign.** A Cr 7000 creditor moved under `Sundry Debtors` stays Cr 7000, bills intact. | Alter Ledger - ZZ Audit Supplier |
| L-05 | **A partial Alter keeps everything not sent.** Altering only mobile and e-mail left bills, address and GST untouched. Sending one mailing block with the same `APPLICABLEFROM` replaced the existing block. Whether a different date appends was not tested. | Alter Ledger - ZZ Audit Customer (two entries) |
| L-06 | **Tally does not validate group suitability.** `ISBILLWISEON Yes` and an opening balance on an Indirect Expenses ledger were both kept. | Create Ledger - ZZ Audit Expense |
| L-07 | Same upsert and ghost behaviour as groups: duplicate Create alters (moved the ledger to another group), Alter of a missing name creates, a rejected Create (missing or absent parent) leaves a fetchable ghost with `ALTERID 0`. | duplicate, Orphan, No Parent, Missing entries |
| L-08 | `PARENT` padded with spaces, as in the Explorer sample, is trimmed. `ISADVANCE` on a bill is not returned by any fetch used here. Rename through Alter keeps MASTERID and GUID. | Create Ledger - ZZ Audit Bank; nested lists; rename |
| L-09 | "Pull All Ledgers" returns usable fields (parent, balances, contact) unlike "Pull All Groups". "Ledgers of Group" without `BELONGSTO` returns direct children only. | Pull entries |

Persisted exactly as sent: `PARENT`, `OPENINGBALANCE`, `ISBILLWISEON`, `PRIORSTATENAME`, `COUNTRYOFRESIDENCE`,
`LEDGERMOBILE`, `EMAIL`, `INCOMETAXNUMBER`, bill name / date / amount, GST registration type / place of supply /
GSTIN, and the mailing block (address lines, pincode, mailing name, state, country).

Not tested: `CURRENCYNAME` and other non-ASCII values, bank details, credit period on bills, deleting a ledger that
has vouchers (seen indirectly in the group cascade test: Tally reports `CanDelete No`).

## Step 2 Validation Through the App, Fixes and Recheck (ledgers)

Ledger create / update / delete were made through the running backend (`/ledgers`), each followed by a fetch from
Tally (entries titled `App: ...`). The existing 63 synced ledgers were also compared with Tally field by field.

| # | Found through the app | Fix | Recheck (`App: Recheck after fix: ...`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-01 | **Debit opening balances arrived as credit.** Customer Dr 5000 landed as `5000.00` (Cr); bank Dr 30000 as Cr. | Real-time push now uses the full ledger builder, which signs the balance. | Dr 5000 -> `-5000.00`, Dr 30000 -> `-30000.00`, Cr 7000 -> `7000.00`. |
| B-02 | **Only name, group, balance and bill-wise flag were pushed.** GSTIN, PAN, address, state, pincode, mobile, phone, e-mail, contact, credit limit and period never reached Tally. | Same: one builder for the real-time push and the Desktop Sync Agent. `PAN` tag corrected to `INCOMETAXNUMBER`, GSTIN to `PARTYGSTIN`, mailing block sent once with `APPLICABLEFROM`. | All of them present in Tally, including the GST registration and mailing blocks. |
| B-03 | **Bank details were never pushed.** | Bank ledger: `BANKDETAILS`, `IFSCODE`, `BANKACCHOLDERNAME`. Other ledgers: `PAYMENTDETAILS.LIST` per account. Tags confirmed by experiment first. | Both present; not duplicated by a later alter. |
| B-04 | **Rename duplicated the ledger in Tally** (old MASTERID 821 kept, new 824 created). | The push addresses the name Tally still has; old name kept on the queue row. | Renamed in place: same MASTERID 827, old name gone; sending the rename twice changed nothing more. |
| B-05 | **Delete removed the ledger from the app while Tally refused** (`Cannot be deleted!`, ledger used in a voucher). | Delete returns 409 with Tally's reason and keeps the ledger. | 409, ledger still in the app and Tally; deleted on both sides once the voucher was removed. |
| B-06 | **Mobile number was dropped on create** (kept only on update, inside the address text). | Stored in its own column on create and update; the address suffix the customer screens read is kept. | Mobile returned by the API and present in Tally. |
| B-07 | Two delete requests at once both reached Tally. | One delete per ledger at a time; a delete of something Tally no longer has is settled instead of staying pending. | Parallel deletes: one `200`, one `409`, a single Tally event. Five stale queue rows retried and settled. |

Imported data: all 63 ledgers that exist on both sides match Tally on group, opening balance and sign, bill-wise
flag, GSTIN and mobile. 17 ledgers exist only in the app (earlier test data, never synced to Tally); left alone.

Not changed, for a decision: `LedgerResponse` title-cases every ledger name it returns, so the app shows
`HDFC BANK A/c` as `Hdfc Bank A/C` and `CGST` as `Cgst` (28 of 63 names differ from Tally in case only).

## Idempotency Across All Record Types (added before Step 3)

| Layer | What it guarantees | Where | Check |
|---|---|---|---|
| Request | Identical overlapping writes run once; a write carrying an `Idempotency-Key` runs once per key (10 minutes). Applies to every POST / PUT / PATCH / DELETE except sign-in and the sync bridge upload. | `backend/app/core/idempotency.py`, registered in `main.py` | Unit tests; live: the same group create sent three times produced one group |
| Web app | Every write sends an `Idempotency-Key`; the same write repeated within 3 seconds reuses the key. | fetch wrapper in `frontend-nextjs/src/context/AuthContext.tsx` | Live, as above |
| Sync queue | One pending row per record and action for every record type; a queued Delete closes pending Create / Alter rows; the name Tally still knows the record by is carried forward. | listener at the end of `backend/app/models/portal_core.py` | Unit test |
| Tally push | Rename addresses the old name; a refused delete is not applied locally; a delete of something already absent is settled. | groups and ledgers so far; other record types are checked in their own steps | Steps 1 and 2 rechecks |

Also removed: the title-casing of ledger names in `LedgerResponse`; the API now returns names exactly as stored
(`CGST`, `Capital A/c - Sanjay Sharma`).

---

## Step 3 Summary: Units

Raw XML against Tally. No crash. In the per-entry verification text, `fetch returned no UNIT object` after a rejected
create is the expected outcome, and `@NAME` differences on renames are expected.

| # | Finding | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| U-01 | **`ISSIMPLEUNIT` is mandatory.** A unit sent with only a name is rejected with `BAD UNIT NAME`. | Create Simple Unit - ZZGm (name only) |
| U-02 | **Tally names compound units itself.** A compound sent as `ZZ Custom Pack` was stored as `ZZNos of 12 ZZGm`; the sent name does not exist afterwards. Sending the same create again answers `Unit 'ZZNos of 12 ZZGm' already exists!` (no duplicate). | Create Compound Unit - ZZ Custom Pack (three entries) |
| U-03 | **A compound unit's name changes when its parts change.** Altering the conversion 1000 to 500 renamed it to `ZZKg of 500 ZZGm`; renaming the simple unit `ZZGm` to `ZZGram` renamed both compounds that used it. The old names stop resolving. | Alter Unit entries; Pull all Units with fields |
| U-04 | **Decimal places can go up but not down** (`Cannot Decrease Number of Decimals for 'Unit'!`). The formal name (`ORIGINALNAME`) can be changed; the reference's `BAD ORIGINAL NAME` did not occur. | Alter Unit - ZZKg (two entries) |
| U-05 | A compound needs both simple units to exist first. *(Corrected during the app validation: rejected unit creates **can** leave a ghost object. A simple unit rejected for its name or formal name stays fetchable by name with `ALTERID 0`, survives a restart, and is in no list. See U-11.)* | Create Compound Unit failures; Experiment entries |
| U-06 | Upsert as elsewhere: duplicate Create alters (decimals 0 to 2), Alter of a missing name creates. | ZZNos again; ZZMissing |
| U-07 | A simple unit used by a compound unit cannot be deleted (`CanDelete No`); deleting the compound releases it. Confirmed three times in controlled tests (plain, after a conversion change, after a rename). | Control, T2, T3 entries |
| U-08 | **Unresolved: three test units cannot be deleted** (`ZZKg`, `ZZNos`, `ZZGram`): `Cannot be deleted!`, `CanDelete No`, although every compound unit that used them is gone and no ghost object can be found. Ruled out as the cause: a failed compound create (T1), a conversion change (T2), a rename while in use (T3), a plain alter (ZZFresh). Not yet explained. | Delete Unit - ZZKg / ZZNos / ZZGram; ghost search; T1 to T3 |
| U-09 | "Pull all Units" returns name, formal name (as `MAILINGNAME`), simple/compound flag and `CANDELETE`, but not base unit, additional unit or conversion; a TDL collection with `FETCH` returns those. | Pull entries |

Persisted exactly as sent: `ISSIMPLEUNIT`, `ORIGINALNAME`, `DECIMALPLACES`, `GSTREPUOM`, `BASEUNITS`, `ADDITIONALUNITS`,
`CONVERSION`.

Left in Tally: `ZZKg`, `ZZNos`, `ZZGram` (U-08). Every other test unit was deleted and confirmed gone.

## App: Update units - rename ZZAdd to ZZAdd2 (Tally stopped responding)

- **Time:** 2026-10-09 12:46:15
- **Status:** Tally Crashed
- **Tally result:** TimeoutError: timed out on the health check

**Request Sent:**

```xml
{
  "app_calls_in_order": [
    "PUT /inventory/uoms/17 (compound 'ZZ Pack': conversion 10 -> 20)  -> Tally answered: Unit 'ZZAdd' does not exist!",
    "PUT /inventory/uoms/16 (rename simple unit ZZAdd -> ZZAdd2)        -> no response from Tally (timeout)",
    "PUT /inventory/uoms/15 (ZZApp decimal places 2 -> 0)               -> no response from Tally (timeout)"
  ],
  "context": "ZZAdd existed in Tally only as a ghost (ALTERID 0): its create had been rejected with DUPLICATE ORIGINAL NAME because the app sent ORIGINALNAME equal to NAME. The rename push was an Alter addressed to the new name ZZAdd2 with ORIGINALNAME ZZAdd2."
}
```

**Response Received:**

```xml
(no response: the app's traffic log shows 'Socket timed out / No response from Tally' for the rename push and the push after it)
```

**Verification Result:**

Not verified. The health check that followed timed out. The exact XML the app sent is in the app's sync traffic log (entries 74 and 75).

**Confirmed on the VM (screenshot from the operator):** TallyPrime was blocked by a modal `Error` dialog: `Internal Error. Contact Tally Solutions. Debug location. 'ZZAdd2' (Id:857) is DUPLICATED in Company 'Bhrama Enterprises'!` Tally had not exited; its HTTP server does not answer while the dialog is open.

**Finding U-10:** the app's rename push was `<UNIT NAME="ZZAdd2" Action="Alter">` with `<ORIGINALNAME>ZZAdd2</ORIGINALNAME>` (the app sends the symbol as the formal name when none is given). No unit of that name existed, so Tally created one (Id 857) whose formal name duplicates its own name, and then raised an internal data error instead of the clean `DUPLICATE ORIGINAL NAME` rejection that the same payload gets with `Action="Create"`.

**Verification Result:**

---

## Step 3 Validation Through the App, Fixes and Recheck (units)

| # | Found through the app | Fix | Recheck (`App: Recheck after fix: ...`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| U-10 | **A unit push hung Tally.** The app sent the symbol as the formal name when none was given. As a Create Tally rejects it (`DUPLICATE ORIGINAL NAME`); as an Alter for a name Tally did not have, Tally created a unit that duplicates itself and stopped behind `'ZZAdd2' (Id:857) is DUPLICATED in Company` until restarted. | The formal name is sent only when it differs from the symbol. Before every Create or Alter the backend asks Tally whether the unit exists and sends the matching action, so an Alter is never sent for a unit Tally does not have. | Unit with no formal name created; rename of a unit in use completed; no hang. |
| U-11 | **Tally accepts only letters in a simple unit's name.** Digits, spaces and hyphens are rejected as `BAD UNIT NAME`, and each rejection leaves a ghost unit. | The app refuses such symbols. A ghost found before a push, or left by a rejected Create, is deleted. | `ZZq3` refused by the app with the reason; nothing sent to Tally. |
| U-12 | **Compound units could not be tracked.** The app sent its own name (`ZZ Pack`); Tally stored `ZZApp of 10 ZZAdd`. Later edits addressed a name Tally never had. | A compound unit is always named `<base> of <n> <additional>` in the app; when its parts change, the push addresses the previous derived name. Renaming a simple unit renames its compound units in the app as Tally does. | Sent as `My Pack`, stored on both sides as `ZZq of 10 ZZr`; conversion 10 to 20 and the rename of `ZZq` each updated the same Tally object (MASTERID 859 / 857). |
| U-13 | **The app accepted what Tally refuses**: fewer decimal places, a second unit with the same symbol, deleting a unit still used by a compound unit. All returned 200. | Refused in the app with the reason (400 / 409). A create or change Tally rejects is undone in the app and reported. A delete Tally refuses is not applied. | Each refused with a clear message; Tally untouched. |
| U-14 | **Compound units imported from Tally were stored as simple units** with no base unit, additional unit or conversion, and no formal names. | Importer reads `ORIGINALNAME`, `ISSIMPLEUNIT`, `BASEUNITS`, `ADDITIONALUNITS`, `CONVERSION`; the Desktop Sync Agent fetches them. | After re-import all 13 units match Tally on type, decimals, formal name, parts and conversion. |

Still in Tally and not removable through the API: `ZZApp`, `ZZKg`, `ZZNos`, `ZZGram` (`Cannot be deleted!`, U-08). `ZZApp` is
also in the app, which now refuses to delete it for the same reason. Units created and deleted after the fixes
(`ZZq`, `ZZr`, their compound) deleted cleanly, which points at the ghosts left by the earlier rejected creates as
the cause, but the object holding the references was not found.

## Rule: A Change Tally Refuses Is Not Kept (groups and ledgers, as for units)

- Tally unreachable or not configured: the change is kept in the app and the push stays queued.
- Tally answers and refuses: the change is undone in the app and the caller gets Tally's reason.

Group pushes were moved from JSON to XML so that the reason is available (Tally's JSON reply only counts errors).
The XML carries the same fields; alias, allocation method, used-for-calculation and GST details were confirmed in
Tally (`Experiment: Create Group in XML ...`, `Recheck: group pushed by the app as XML - ZZ Keep`).

| Case (a parent group deleted in Tally behind the app's back) | App | Tally |
|---|---|---|
| Create a group under it | 400 `Tally did not accept this group: Group 'ZZ Gone' does not exist!`; group not in the app | No group, no ghost |
| Rename, move and change `ZZ Keep` under it | 400 with the same reason; name, parent, alias, flags, allocation and GST row all restored | `ZZ Keep` unchanged |
| Create a ledger under it | 400; ledger not in the app | No ledger, no ghost |
| Rename, move and change `ZZ Keep Ledger` under it | 400; name, group, balance and mobile restored | Ledger unchanged |

The first run of the ledger edit case failed with a server error in the new undo path (a function-local import
shadowed `delete`); fixed and repeated. Pending queue was 0 afterwards and all test records were removed.

## Step 4 Summary: Stock Groups

Raw XML against Tally. No crash. All `ZZ SG` test stock groups were deleted and confirmed gone (10 stock groups remain,
as before). In the per-entry verification text, `fetch returned no None object` only means no automatic diff was
requested for that entry.

| # | Finding | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| S-01 | **A stock group created with only a name gets `ISADDABLE No`**, although the reference says the default is Yes. Send the flag explicitly. | Create Stock Group - ZZ SG Main |
| S-02 | Alias (`LANGUAGENAME.LIST`), HSN details and GST rate details persist as sent and survive a later partial Alter that moves the group. Like other masters, an Object export returns those lists empty; a collection with `FETCH` returns them. | Create / Alter Stock Group - ZZ SG Taxed; Fetch nested lists |
| S-03 | A stock group is moved to the top level by sending `<PARENT>&#4; Primary</PARENT>`. A Create that omits `PARENT` on an existing name leaves its parent unchanged. | Alter ZZ SG Taxed; ZZ SG Sub again |
| S-04 | **Tally refuses a circular hierarchy cleanly**: making a group the child of its own sub-group answers `Stock Group 'ZZ SG Sub Renamed' is already a child of this!`, nothing changes. | Alter Stock Group - ZZ SG Main |
| S-05 | Same upsert and ghost behaviour as account groups: duplicate Create alters, Alter of a missing name creates, a Create with a missing parent is rejected (`EXCEPTIONS 1`) but leaves a ghost stock group with `ALTERID 0` that a Delete removes. | ZZ SG Sub again; ZZ SG Missing; ZZ SG Orphan |
| S-06 | Rename through Alter keeps MASTERID and GUID; the old name stops resolving. A stock group with a sub-group cannot be deleted (`Cannot be deleted!`). | rename; Delete entries |
| S-07 | "Pull All Stock Groups" returns names only (no parent). The Explorer's "Zero Balance" sample names its filter `TSPL Zero Closing` but defines `TSPL ZeroClosing`; it was not sent as printed, since a formula Tally cannot resolve can stop it behind an error dialog. With the name corrected it works. | Pull entries |

Persisted exactly as sent: `PARENT`, `ISADDABLE`, alias, `HSNCODE`, `TAXABILITY` and the three GST rates.

## Step 4 Validation Through the App, Fixes and Recheck (stock groups)

| # | Found through the app | Fix | Recheck (`App: Recheck after fix: ...`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| SG-01 | **Aliases never reached Tally.** | Sent as the group's name list; the list is sent whole, so a removed alias is removed in Tally. | Alias present in Tally; changing it replaced it. |
| SG-02 | **A second group with the same name (different case) was accepted and overwrote the first in Tally**, moving the sub-group to the top level. | Names are unique in the app without regard to case. | `zz fix sg sub` refused with `already exists`. |
| SG-03 | **Rename created a second stock group in Tally** (MASTERID 875 kept, 877 created). | The push addresses the name Tally still has; old name kept on the queue row. | Renamed in place (MASTERID 879); the sub-group followed its parent. |
| SG-04 | **The app accepted a loop** (a group placed under its own sub-group), leaving a cycle in its own data. | Refused in the app. | 400 `cannot be placed under one of its own sub-groups`. |
| SG-05 | **Delete removed the group in the app whatever Tally said**, and with sub-groups or items in it. | Refused in the app when it still contains sub-groups or stock items (they are named); a delete Tally refuses is not applied. | 409 naming the sub-group; 409 with Tally's `Cannot be deleted!` for a sub-group only Tally had; deleted on both sides once it was empty. Two deletes at once produced one Tally event. |
| SG-06 | A create or edit Tally refused was kept in the app. | Undone in the app, with Tally's reason; a ghost left by a refused create is removed. | Create and edit under a parent missing in Tally both refused with `Stock Group 'ZZ Fix SG Gone' does not exist!`; app unchanged; no ghost. |
| SG-07 | **Edited related rows were pushed stale**: the push reused the group already loaded in the request, so a changed alias went out with its old value. The same applied to a ledger's edited bank accounts. | Pushes for stock groups, ledgers and groups reload the record and its related rows. | Alias change reached Tally; a ledger's bank account changed from 1111111111 to 2222222222 in Tally. |

Imported data: the 10 stock groups that exist on both sides match Tally on parent; none has an alias in Tally. The
importer now reads aliases. Left as they are: two stock groups that exist only in the app (`NIRVAAN METALIKAS`,
`CELLTONE HOME APPLIANCES`), and the ` Primary` row the importer keeps as the parent of top-level stock groups.

## Step 5 Summary: Stock Items

Raw XML against Tally. No crash. Every `ZZ Item` test item and the test stock group were deleted and confirmed
gone (30 stock items remain, as before). In the per-entry verification text, `fetch returned no None object` only
means no automatic diff was requested for that entry.

| # | Finding | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| I-01 | **Opening stock lives in the batch allocation, not on the item.** An Alter that changes `OPENINGBALANCE` / `OPENINGVALUE` at item level without `BATCHALLOCATIONS.LIST` answers `ALTERED 1` and changes nothing (still 100 Kg). Sent with its batch allocation, it takes effect. | Alter Stock Item - ZZ Item Full (item level only; with batch allocation) |
| I-02 | **A batch allocation list replaces the previous one.** Repeating the same 40 Kg request leaves 40 Kg (no doubling); sending it for another godown moves the stock there rather than adding a second batch. | Alter Stock Item - ZZ Item Full (repeated; another godown) |
| I-03 | **Tally creates a default batch when none is sent**: opening stock without a batch allocation is stored under `Main Location` / `Primary Batch`. | Create Stock Item - ZZ Item Loose |
| I-04 | **Quantity, rate and value are not reconciled, and the sign of the value is not checked.** 10 nos at 50/nos with value `+999.00` was stored as sent; the item's rate was recomputed to 99.90/nos while its batch kept 50.00/nos. Tally's own data uses a negative opening value (debit). | Create Stock Item - ZZ Item Loose |
| I-05 | **The base unit cannot be changed once the item has stock** (`Incorrect Units for Item ...`); with no stock a duplicate Create silently changed it from nos to Kg. | Alter ZZ Item Full (base unit); ZZ Item Basic again |
| I-06 | An item needs neither a unit nor a group: created with only a name it sits under `Primary` with base unit `Not Applicable`. An item with opening stock can still be deleted. | Create ZZ Item NoUnit; Delete ZZ Item Full |
| I-07 | Same upsert and ghost behaviour as other masters: duplicate Create alters, Alter of a missing name creates, a Create with a missing unit or stock group is rejected (`EXCEPTIONS 1`) but leaves a ghost item with `ALTERID 0` that a Delete removes. | ZZ Item Basic again; ZZ Item Missing; ZZ Item BadUnit; ZZ Item Orphan |
| I-08 | Category, description, alias, alternate unit with conversion and denominator, HSN and GST rate details persist as sent and survive a partial Alter. Quantities come back formatted to the unit's decimals (`100.000 Kg`). Rename keeps MASTERID and GUID. | Create / Alter ZZ Item Full; ZZ Item AltUnit; rename |
| I-09 | "Pull All Stock Item" returns names only. Batch, GST and alias lists are empty in an Object export and need a collection with `FETCH`. "Items of Stock Group" without `BELONGSTO` returns direct children only. | Pull entries |

| SI-01 | **Aliases, the alternate unit and GST rates never reached Tally.** The GST block used tags Tally ignores. | Aliases sent as the name list; alternate unit as `ADDITIONALUNITS` / `CONVERSION` / `DENOMINATOR`; HSN and GST in `HSNDETAILS.LIST` and `GSTDETAILS.LIST` with one rate per duty head. | Alias present; `100.000 Kg = 100000 gm`; IGST 18, CGST 9, SGST/UTGST 9. |
| SI-02 | **A second item with the same name in another case was accepted.** | Names are unique in the app without regard to case. | `zz ai basic` refused with `already exists`. |
| SI-03 | Rename would create a second item (same cause as other masters). | The push addresses the name Tally still has. | Two renames in a row kept MASTERID 906; old names gone. |
| SI-04 | **Clearing opening stock in the app left it in Tally** (nothing was sent when the quantity was zero), and edited opening rows were pushed stale. | Opening stock is always sent as a batch list, empty when there is none; the push reloads the item and its rows. | 100 Kg changed to 40 in another godown: moved, not added. Cleared item shows no opening stock and no batch in Tally. |
| SI-05 | A create or edit Tally refused was kept in the app. | The change is sent to Tally before it is committed; a refusal rolls the whole request back (item, aliases, opening rows) and returns Tally's reason. | Create and edit under a stock group missing in Tally both refused with `Stock Group 'ZZ AI Gone' does not exist!`; item not created; existing item unchanged in every field; no ghost in Tally; pending queue 0. |
| SI-06 | Delete removed the item in the app whatever Tally said. | Refused in the app while vouchers or other records still use the item; a delete Tally refuses is not applied. | Two deletes at once produced one Tally event; items gone on both sides. The refused-by-Tally case was not exercised (it needs an item used in a voucher). |
| SI-07 | **Imported items lacked what a push now sends back**: alternate unit, aliases, description and the opening batches (godown and batch name). An edit in the app would have wiped or renamed them in Tally. | Importer reads all four; the Desktop Sync Agent fetches the alternate-unit fields. | After re-import all 30 items on both sides match on group, unit, alternate unit, opening quantity and alias count; `Coffee Beans` holds batch `Batch1`, 200 at 400. |

Left as they are: 12 stock items that exist only in the app (`Microchip Sensor IC-5043` and similar test sets).
Not tested: editing an imported item through the app and confirming Tally is unchanged afterwards.

## Stock Items: Follow-up Fixes

| Item | What was done | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Round trip on real items | Seven imported items were re-saved unchanged through the app, with Tally's full state of each compared before and after (`Round trip: ...` entries, `tally_audit/roundtrip.py`). | The first run exposed three bugs, fixed below. Final state: `GST Coffee`, `Decaf Coffee`, `Coffee Powder`, `Computer2`, `Coffee Beans` unchanged; `Ink Pens` and `Dell OptiPlex Desktop` differ only by `LANGUAGEID 1033` now being set on their name list. |
| RT-1 | The app had stored Tally's `Not Applicable` category marker as a real category, so the save was refused (`Stock Category 'Not Applicable' does not exist!`). The undo rule left the app unchanged. | Importer treats it as "no category" and removes the stored row; the push sends Tally's marker for a missing category or unit. |
| RT-2 | **`Coffee Beans` was changed in Tally by the test**: batch tracking went from Yes to No, its batch `Batch1` became `Primary Batch`, and GST was switched on. Cause: the batch flag was never fetched from Tally, and the push sent GST tags for every item. | Restored by hand (`Restore: Stock Item - Coffee Beans`), then fixed: the agent fetches the batch and costing flags, an absent flag no longer overwrites, and the second round trip left the item unchanged. One residue: its name list now carries `LANGUAGEID 1033`. |
| RT-3 | An unchanged save would have rewritten an item's dated GST entries (Tally keeps cess heads and valuation types the app does not hold). | HSN and GST are sent for a new item, or when the edit changes them; otherwise left alone. `GST Coffee` and `Decaf Coffee` unchanged after a save. |
| Alternate-unit precision | The ratio is stored as Tally's pair (`alt_unit_conversion` alternate units = new column `alt_unit_denominator` base units) in the model, API, importer, push, the item form and the voucher item row. | `Coffee Beans` holds 1 / 1000 exactly, as in Tally. |
| Records only in the app | 12 stock items and 17 ledgers re-saved unchanged, which pushed them. The item push now asks Tally whether the item exists and sends a Create (with tax details) when it does not. | Tally has 42 stock items and 79 ledgers, matching the app. Pending queue 0. |
| Found on the way | Saving a stock item that has a bill of materials returned a server error: the response looped over the BOMs where it meant their components. The four `Smart IoT Tracker` items could not be saved. | Fixed, with a test; all four saved with their 2 components intact. |
| Sync agent restart | No Desktop Sync Agent process is running on this machine, so there was nothing to restart. The new fetch lists apply the next time it is started. | - |

Still to do, in Step 6: a stock item delete that Tally refuses because the item is used in a voucher.

## Incident: a real voucher was deleted during Step 6, and restored

While removing two test receipts that had been created without an identifier, a delete was sent in the
`DATE` / `TAGNAME="Voucher Number"` / `TAGVALUE="43"` form with `VCHTYPE="Receipt"`. Tally ignored the voucher
type and deleted the voucher numbered 43 on that date of another type: **Sales no. 43, 1-Mar-2026, Akshaya
Enterprises, 1180.00** (master id 168; the reply's `LASTVCHID` showed it). Entry: `Delete Receipt - by voucher
number tag`.

Restored from the app's copy of the voucher (`Restore: Sales number 43 ...`): Akshaya Enterprises Dr 1180.00,
GST Sales Cr 1000.00 with 1 nos Apple MacBook Pro Laptop at 1000.00, CGST Cr 90.00, SGST Cr 90.00. Differences
from the original that could not be avoided or are not known:

- Tally numbered it **63**, not 43 (the Sales type numbers automatically, and an Alter asking for 43 was ignored);
  its master id is now 380.
- The bill allocation was sent as `On Account`; the original's reference, if it had one, and its narration are not
  held by the app.
- The app still shows this voucher as no. 43 and is linked to the old identifier.

No other voucher was affected: the receipts before and after were compared, and every other delete in this step
was by this audit's own REMOTEID or by exact master id (confirmed by `LASTVCHID`).

---

## Step 6 Summary: Accounting Vouchers (Receipt, Payment, Sales, Purchase)

Raw XML against Tally. No crash. All test vouchers, ledgers and the test item were deleted (0 vouchers with a test
narration remain, any date).

| # | Finding | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| V-01 | **A voucher sent with a REMOTEID is updated in place when sent again** (`CREATED 0, ALTERED 1`), even with `ACTION="Create"`. **Sent without one, every send adds a voucher**: three sends, two extra receipts. | Create Receipt again (three entries) |
| V-02 | **Tally does not give the REMOTEID back.** Exports carry Tally's own GUID in `REMOTEID` and `$RemoteID` does not match ours, yet imports (Create, Alter, Delete) match on the id first sent. A voucher cannot be looked up by our id; it must be remembered on our side. | Experiment: find the receipt by ... |
| V-03 | **Never delete by voucher number.** The `TAGNAME="Voucher Number"` form ignores `VCHTYPE` and deleted a Sales voucher while addressed to a Receipt (see the incident above). Delete by our REMOTEID, or by `TAGNAME="MASTERID"`, which matched exactly. Tally's own GUID with `VCHKEY`, as in the Explorer's Delete sample, answered `Voucher does not exist!` for vouchers created through the API. | Delete Receipt entries |
| V-04 | **A rejected voucher leaves a hidden ghost** that holds its ledgers: after the unbalanced and missing-ledger receipts were rejected, `ZZ V Customer` could not be deleted (`CanDelete No`, no voucher visible) until both were deleted by their REMOTEID (`DELETED 1` each). | Create Receipt with debit 1000 ...; Teardown entries |
| V-05 | An unbalanced voucher is rejected with `EXCEPTIONS 1` and **no reason text**; a missing ledger gives `Ledger '...' does not exist!`. | reject entries |
| V-06 | **Not rejected:** a date after the current period (1-Apr-2026) was accepted and stored outside the period, where a period-limited lookup does not see it; a bill allocation of 600 on a party line of 1000 was accepted and stored as 1000. | reject entries; leftovers check beyond the period |
| V-07 | Alter with the full voucher replaces it; **Alter with only `DATE` keeps the lines** and moves the voucher (its `VCHKEY` changes with the date). Alter under an id never sent creates a voucher. | alter entries |
| V-08 | Deleting again a voucher already deleted under the same REMOTEID answers `Cannot be deleted!`, not `Voucher does not exist!`. | Delete Receipt - REMOTEID zz-v-receipt-cash (second) |
| V-09 | Everything sent persisted: debit/credit lines, bill allocations (`New Ref` with name, `On Account`), cheque details in `BANKALLOCATIONS.LIST`, item, quantity, rate, godown and batch. Nested lists are returned only when fetched explicitly (`ALLLEDGERENTRIES.BILLALLOCATIONS.*` and similar). Sales and Purchase sent with inventory on the ledger line are stored by Tally in its invoice form (`ALLINVENTORYENTRIES.LIST`, `LEDGERENTRIES.LIST`). | Create entries; nested fetch experiments |
| V-10 | The Explorer's "for a period" sample names its filter `Period Filter` but defines `PeriodFilter`; sent with one name it works. "Pull all Receipt vouchers" works as printed. | pull entries |
| V-11 | A stock item created through the app and used in a Tally voucher: the app's delete returned 409 with `Cannot be deleted!` and kept the item; after the voucher was removed the delete succeeded on both sides. (The case left open in Step 5.) | Setup: Purchase voucher using ZZ V AppItem |

Still stuck in Tally from Step 3: units `ZZApp`, `ZZKg`, `ZZNos`, `ZZGram`. Deleting the names of their rejected
compound units, as worked for ghost vouchers, found nothing.

## Step 6 through the app: findings, fixes and recheck (vouchers)

Probes against Tally first (entries `Probe: ...`), then every operation through the running app (entries `App: ...`),
then the same flows with the connection to Tally cut (`step6_offline.py`). No crash. No test voucher, ledger or item is
left in Tally or in the app; the sync queue is empty.

### What Tally does (probes)

| # | Finding |
|---|---|
| P-01 | The import reply carries `LASTVCHID`, the master id of the voucher just created or altered. Its `VCHNUMBER` only echoes the number that was sent. |
| P-02 | **Tally numbers automatic voucher types itself and ignores the number sent** (9001 sent, 47 stored; 9002 sent, 49 stored). The real number has to be read back by master id. |
| P-03 | **Tally's own GUID does not work as a `REMOTEID`.** `Alter` and `Create` under it make a second voucher; `Delete` under it removes only that second one. A voucher keyed inside Tally can only be addressed by `TAGNAME="MASTERID"`. |
| P-04 | `TAGNAME="MASTERID"` finds the voucher only together with the **date it currently has in Tally** (the `DATE` attribute). With a new date there, or a master id that does not exist, `Alter` silently creates a voucher. |
| P-05 | `ACTION="Cancel"` by master id cancels in place and keeps the number. Lookups by `$MasterID` or `$GUID` need no period. |
| P-06 | Deleting by master id a voucher that is already gone answers `Cannot be deleted!`, the same text as a real refusal. |

### What was wrong in the app, and what it does now

| # | Was | Now |
|---|---|---|
| VA-01 | The app's own counter numbered the voucher (Receipt "1") while Tally stored it under its own number (53). The two never met. | The app's number is **provisional**. After each push the app reads the voucher back by master id and stores Tally's number, master id, GUID and date. A bill named after the provisional number is renamed on both sides. The app's counter follows Tally's. |
| VA-02 | An imported voucher was pushed with `REMOTEID` = Tally's GUID: **every edit from the app made a second voucher in Tally**, a cancel made a blank cancelled voucher, a delete did nothing. | A voucher Tally holds is located first (by master id, else GUID) and addressed by master id and Tally's date. Only a voucher Tally has never held goes under the app's own `REMOTEID` (`MYTALLY-VCH-<id>`), which Tally matches on re-send. |
| VA-03 | An edit that moved the date created a second voucher (found during this recheck, see `Edit Receipt ... FIRST ATTEMPT`). | Addressed to the date Tally holds; the new date travels inside. |
| VA-04 | A create or edit Tally refused stayed in the app as a failed sync row. | Sent before commit: a refusal rolls the whole request back (voucher, lines, stock, bills, the number) and returns Tally's reason (400). The hidden leftover of a refused create is removed by its `REMOTEID`. |
| VA-05 | A delete removed the voucher in the app whatever Tally said. | Refused by Tally: 409, kept. Tally unreachable: deleted in the app, queued with its identifiers, deleted in Tally later by master id. Already gone in Tally: settled (`ALREADY_ABSENT`). |
| VA-06 | A queued delete could not be replayed (the voucher row was gone), and the delete-audit retry fell back to **delete by voucher number**. | Identifiers ride on the queue row and the audit row. Nothing deletes by voucher number any more. |
| VA-07 | Editing did not save the narration. The supplier's invoice number was not sent. | Both sent (`NARRATION`, `REFERENCE`). |
| VA-08 | The Desktop Sync Agent acknowledged a pushed voucher without telling the app its number. | The agent reads `LASTVCHID`, looks the voucher up and reports it (`POST /sync/voucher-identities`). Not run live: no agent on this machine. |
| VA-09 | Storing the alter id of the app's own push would have raised the inbound watermark past changes made in Tally just before (seen in this recheck: a receipt entered in Tally was skipped). | The alter id is only taken from the inbound sync. |

### Recheck through the app

| Case | Result |
|---|---|
| Create Receipt | Tally no. 53, app shows 53 (was provisionally 1), master id and GUID stored |
| Same create sent twice at once; two re-pushes | one voucher, altered in place |
| Edit (amount, date, narration) | same voucher, same number |
| Purchase and Sales item invoices | item, quantity, rate, godown, batch, bill reference stored; sales bill named after Tally's number (75) |
| Create and edit refused by Tally (ledger missing there) | 400 with Tally's reason; nothing kept, counter unchanged |
| Cancel, twice | cancelled in Tally, number kept |
| Delete, twice at once and again | one delete; then 404 |
| **Tally unreachable:** create, edit, create+delete, create+cancel | kept with provisional numbers and queued |
| **Meanwhile a Receipt entered in Tally** took no. 55, the app's provisional number | on reconnect the app's receipt became **56**; Tally's kept 55; one of each |
| Queue re-sent | no change; delete of a never-sent voucher settled without touching Tally |
| Delete made while Tally was unreachable | deleted in Tally by master id on reconnect; second send settled |
| Inbound sync | the receipt entered in Tally imported once with its master id; vouchers pushed by the app matched by GUID, no copies |
| Edit and delete, from the app, of the receipt entered in Tally | altered in place, then deleted |

Tests: `backend/tests/test_voucher_tally_sync.py`, 14 cases against a fake Tally that behaves as P-01 to P-06. Suite: 160 passed.

### Corrections to the incident record above

The restore of Sales no. 43 answered `ALTERED 1`, not `CREATED 1`: it did not make a new voucher. Master id 380 already
existed as a blank cancelled Sales no. 63, which the app's old code had created under the original's GUID (VA-02). The
restore filled that voucher. Tally holds 13 more such blank cancelled vouchers from the same defect (master ids 369-382
except 380: Sales 56-62, 64, 65; Purchase 24; Payments 29-31). They were left alone.

App side: the app held two rows for this voucher (ids 108 and 124). Row 108, whose Tally voucher no longer exists, was
removed with its stock effect reversed; row 124 is Sales no. 63, master id 380. App voucher 132 (`upi check`, pushed
before identifiers were stored) was linked to its Tally voucher, Sales no. 73, master id 265, after party, amount, date and
narration matched.

## Incident 2: a real voucher was deleted while removing app-only vouchers, and restored

- **Time:** 2026-10-09 21:45:07
- **Status:** Success

**Request Sent:**

```xml
DELETE /vouchers/135 (one of the 12 app vouchers dated 22-23 Aug 2026 that had no Tally identity)
```

**Response Received:**

```xml
200, tally_status SUCCESS: Tally answered DELETED 1, LASTVCHID 264
```

**Verification Result:**

Cause: a voucher with no stored identifier was addressed as REMOTEID MYTALLY-VCH-<row id>. Row id 135 had been used in August by a different voucher, which Tally still held under that REMOTEID as master id 264: Sales no. 72, 1-Mar-2026, Akshaya Enterprises, 1221.00, narration 'upi check' (app row 131). The delete of app voucher 135 removed it from Tally. The other 11 deletes answered 'Cannot be deleted!' and removed nothing.

Fix: the REMOTEID is now random (MYTALLY-<uuid>), stored on the voucher at its first send and never derived from the row id; a voucher with no stored identifier sends nothing to Tally when deleted; the retry endpoints no longer replay an old queue row (the first restore attempt replayed an August 'Delete' row for id 131, which Tally answered with nothing to delete). Test: test_a_reused_row_id_never_reaches_another_voucher_in_tally.

Restore: sent again from the app's copy (POST /vouchers/131/retry-sync). State in Tally now: {'MASTERID': [' 333'], 'VOUCHERNUMBER': ['76'], 'DATE': ['20260301'], 'PARTYLEDGERNAME': ['Akshaya Enterprises'], 'NARRATION': ['upi check'], 'ISCANCELLED': ['No'], 'STOCKITEMNAME': ['Computer 50'], 'RATE': ['111.00/nos'], 'ACTUALQTY': [' 11 nos', ' 11 nos'], 'GODOWNNAME': ['Main Location'], 'BATCHNAME': ['Primary Batch'], 'lines': [('GST Sales', '1221.00'), ('Akshaya Enterprises', '-1221.00')], 'bills': [('76', 'New Ref')]}

## Step 6 follow-up: cleanup, a second incident, and the two live tests

**Blank cancelled vouchers.** The 13 the old edit defect had left in Tally (Sales 56-62, 64, 65; Purchase 24; Payments 29-31) were
deleted through the app, each located by its GUID and deleted by its exact master id. In the master id range 369-382 only the
restored Sales no. 63 (380) remains.

**App-only vouchers.** The 12 app vouchers dated 22-23 Aug 2026 (ids 133-144) were deleted through the app. Eleven had nothing
in Tally. The twelfth removed a real voucher from Tally: see `Incident 2` above. Sales no. 72 (Akshaya Enterprises, 1221.00,
`upi check`) was sent again from the app's intact copy and is now **Sales no. 76**, master id 333, with the same party, item
(11 nos Computer 50 at 111.00), amount and narration; its bill reference is now `76`.

| # | Was | Now |
|---|---|---|
| VA-10 | A voucher with no stored identifier was addressed as `MYTALLY-VCH-<row id>`. Row ids had been reused, so that id could belong to another voucher in Tally. | The identifier is random (`MYTALLY-<uuid>`), stored at the first send, never derived from the row id. A voucher with no stored identifier sends nothing to Tally when deleted. |
| VA-11 | "Retry sync" replayed the last queue row for the voucher's row id, which could be an old `Delete` of a voucher that had the id before. | Only a row still waiting is re-sent, never a delete; otherwise a fresh row for the voucher as it is. |
| VA-12 | The agent sent a master-id payload under the date the backend last knew. | The agent looks the voucher up first and addresses it under the date Tally holds now. |
| VA-13 | Queue rows acknowledged by the agent kept their old status text. | Marked `SUCCESS`. |

**Live: a delete Tally refuses.** Tally did not refuse a delete for any business reason tried (a voucher carrying an IRN, a
bank-reconciled receipt, a voucher whose bill a later receipt had settled: all deleted). A refusal was produced by changing the
voucher's date in Tally between the app's lookup and its delete: Tally answered `Voucher does not exist!` while still holding the
voucher; the app answered **409** and kept it, with no queue row left. Entry: `App: delete a Receipt while its date is changed in Tally ...`.

**Live: the Desktop Sync Agent.** The real agent code ran one outbound cycle against Tally and the running backend, with a
temporary login (removed afterwards). A receipt created and edited while the backend could not reach Tally was pushed once (two
sends, one voucher) and came back with Tally's master id, GUID and number; an edit of a voucher whose date had been moved in
Tally was applied in place. Entry: `Agent: one outbound cycle ...`.

Tests: backend 161 passed, agent 17 passed. No test voucher, ledger or login is left; the sync queue is empty; every app voucher
(118) is linked to exactly one Tally voucher.

## App data rebuilt from Tally, then every operation re-run through the app

**Tally had changed.** Before the wipe, Tally held 44 vouchers, 53 ledgers and 19 stock items, against 118 / 79 / 42 an hour
earlier, and the vouchers restored earlier in this audit were not there. No request in this log removed them; the company data
appears to have been restored or reverted on the VM. The app was rebuilt from what Tally holds now.

**Backup, wipe, resync.** All 1,400 rows of the app's copy were written to `tally_audit/backups/app_tally_data_2026-10-09/`
(one JSON file per table), then every `tally_sync` table, the sync queue and the delete audit were emptied
(`tally_audit/app_data_reset.py`). The resync was run through the real Desktop Sync Agent code (full inbound). App after resync
against Tally: groups 31 (+1), ledgers 53, units 5 (+1), stock groups 8, stock categories 3, stock items 19, godowns 3,
voucher types 24, cost centres 5, vouchers 44. The two extra rows are placeholders the app needs: group `Primary` (holds
`Profit & Loss A/c`, whose parent in Tally is the top level) and unit `Not Applicable` (for two items with no unit).
Not in Tally, so not restored: 4 bills of materials, 1 payment link, 1 GST reconciliation setting (all in the backup).

**Tally's identifiers on every record.** Vouchers, groups and ledgers already had a GUID column; units, stock groups and stock
items now have one too, and all six types store Tally's master id. After the resync every record of these types carries both
(31/53/5/8/19/44, no GUID twice). A record created or changed through the app reads its GUID and master id back from Tally
right after the push; the inbound sync then matches by GUID first, so a rename made in Tally updates the same app record.

| # | Found by starting from empty or by the re-run | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| R-01 | The import stored Tally's markers as records: group ` Primary`, unit ` Not Applicable`, stock category ` Primary` (leading space from the control character). | Trimmed and treated as markers; the stock category marker is no longer stored. |
| R-02 | An item at Tally's top level was given an invented stock group `General` when a voucher used it. A later push would have sent that group to Tally as its parent. | Items keep the group Tally gives them. |
| R-03 | The agent never pulled stock categories, cost categories or cost centres. | Added to its collections. |
| R-04 | Sub-groups were refused under any group with `ISADDABLE No`. In Tally that flag is "nett debit/credit balances for reporting"; every group can have sub-groups. | Check removed. |
| R-05 | **One watermark for everything.** Tally counts changes to vouchers and to masters separately (`ALTVCHID` 335, `ALTMSTID` 756 here). With masters ahead, the incremental sync asked for vouchers changed after 731 and skipped a receipt entered in Tally. `/sync/last-alter-id` also returned 0 for its per-type values (wrong table names). | Separate master and voucher watermarks in the backend and the agent. |
| R-06 | Reading the identity back after a push reloaded the record being returned; creating a ledger answered 500 although it was saved (my change, caught in this run). | Read and written as plain columns. |
| R-07 | Voucher type counters started at 1 after an import, so provisional numbers were far from Tally's. | Seeded from the imported numbers (three of four test vouchers got the number Tally then gave them). |
| R-08 | The stock item API responses were built by hand and did not show the identifiers. | Added. |

**Re-run through the app** (entries `After resync, through the app: ...` and `After resync - ...`): for groups, ledgers, units,
stock groups and stock items: create, duplicate create (400), rename/edit, delete; identifiers stored by the app equal
Tally's in every case and a rename kept the same Tally record. Vouchers: receipt sent twice at once (one voucher), edit with a
date move, purchase and sales item invoices, payment and cancel; master ids and GUIDs equal Tally's. Deleting an item or ledger
still used: 409, kept. A ledger under a group missing in Tally: 400 with Tally's reason, not kept. In Tally itself: a ledger
renamed and a receipt entered; after the agent's incremental sync the app's ledger kept its id under the new name and the
receipt arrived once, then was edited from the app in place. All test records were deleted through the app.

Final state: app equals Tally by count for every type, sync queue empty, no test record or temporary login left.
Tests: backend 163 passed, agent 17 passed.

## Step 7 Summary: the remaining voucher types (raw XML against Tally)

Create under a REMOTEID, the same create sent again, Alter / Cancel / Delete by exact master id, with a read-back after each.
No crash. No test voucher, ledger or item is left (`tally_audit/step7_voucher_types.py`).

| Type | Create | Repeat | Alter | Cancel | Delete | Shape Tally needs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contra, Journal | OK | same voucher | OK | OK | OK | `ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST`, Accounting Voucher View |
| Credit Note, Debit Note | OK | same voucher | OK | OK | OK | `ALLINVENTORYENTRIES.LIST` + `LEDGERENTRIES.LIST`, Invoice Voucher View. Credit Note: stock in, party credited, sales ledger. Debit Note: stock out, party debited, purchase ledger. |
| Delivery Note, Receipt Note | OK | same voucher | OK | OK | OK | Same shape as Sales / Purchase |
| Stock Journal | OK | same voucher | OK | OK | OK | `INVENTORYENTRIESIN.LIST` + `INVENTORYENTRIESOUT.LIST`, **Consumption Voucher View**, no ledger lines |
| Physical Stock | OK | - | OK | OK | OK | `INVENTORYENTRIESIN.LIST` with quantity only, **Consumption Voucher View**. With any other view or list it is refused with `EXCEPTIONS 1` and no reason. |
| Attendance | OK | same voucher | OK | OK | OK | `ATTENDANCEENTRIES.LIST` (`NAME` employee, `ATTENDANCETYPE`, `ATTDTYPETIMEVALUE`). Its entries come back only with `NATIVEMETHOD *.*`, not with a `FETCH` of the list. |
| Payroll | OK | same voucher | OK | OK | OK | `CATEGORYENTRY.LIST` > `EMPLOYEEENTRIES.LIST` > `PAYHEADALLOCATIONS.LIST` plus `ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST`, PaySlip Voucher View, `ASPAYSLIP Yes` |

Attendance and Payroll need the masters Tally already has here (employee `Ashish`, attendance type `Present`, pay heads).

## Step 7 through the app: Contra, Journal, Credit Note, Debit Note, Delivery Note, Receipt Note

**`REMOTEALTGUID` (the element TallyConnector sends its identifier in).** Tally does not match a re-sent voucher on it: two sends
made two vouchers (`Probe: Create Journal with a REMOTEALTGUID element ...`). It does store the value and return it. The app now
sends its identifier there as well as in the `REMOTEID` attribute, and the import recognises a voucher by it when the GUID is not
known yet (a push whose reply was lost), instead of importing it as a second voucher.

**Defect fixed.** Stock direction and sales/purchase side were one flag, right only for Sales and Purchase:

| Type | Was | Now (as Tally stores it) |
|---|---|---|
| Credit Note | purchase ledger | stock arrives, customer credited, **sales** ledger |
| Debit Note | sales ledger | stock leaves, supplier debited, **purchase** ledger |
| Delivery Note | stock arriving, supplier-style, purchase ledger | stock **leaves**, customer debited, **sales** ledger |
| Receipt Note | correct | unchanged |

The rule lives in `backend/app/services/voucher_kinds.py` and is used by the push, the app's own stock posting and the ledger
lines the backend adds when the form sends only a party and item lines.

**Recheck through the app** (entries `App: Create Contra, Journal, ...` onwards). For all six: create, edit (amount or quantity,
date, narration), cancel, delete; Tally's number, master id and GUID stored; the identifier came back from Tally on every voucher.
Stock direction and ledger in Tally matched the table above, and the app's stock for the test item returned to 0. The four note
types were also sent the way the form sends them (party and item lines only): the ledger lines the backend added were on the
right side and the right ledger. Delivery and Receipt Notes carry no bill reference in Tally. Everything was deleted afterwards.

Tests: backend 175 passed (new: `test_voucher_kinds.py`, and a lost-reply voucher recognised on import).

backend) now fetch the two lists.

## Step 9: Physical Stock, Attendance and Payroll through the app

### Physical Stock

Push: the counted quantity per item in `INVENTORYENTRIESIN.LIST`, Consumption Voucher View, no rate or amount (the one shape Tally
accepts). Import: the same list read back as counts. Form: a "Counted stock" view (item, counted quantity).

A count says "on this date there were N". The first version kept each count as a fixed adjustment, and the live run showed the
flaw: with a count of 9 on 1-Mar cancelled and a count of 7 on 2-Mar standing, the app said -2 where Tally said 7. Now, for any
item that has counts, the adjustments and the item's stock are re-derived in date order whenever a voucher touching it is
entered, changed, cancelled, deleted or imported (`backend/app/services/stock_counts.py`): everything dated up to a count is
absorbed by it, only later movements change the stock.

Live (entries `App: Physical Stock ...`): count 12, recount 9: Tally's closing stock 9, app 9. A count of 5 entered in Tally:
imported, app 5. Recounted from the app to 7 in place; earlier count cancelled: Tally 7, app 7. Both deleted: app 0.

### Attendance and Payroll

Masters now read from Tally: employees (cost centres marked for payroll), attendance types, pay heads (ledgers with a pay
type). Here: employee `Ashish`, type `Present`, pay heads `Basic Salary`, `DA`, `TA`. `GET /vouchers/payroll-masters` lists them.

Attendance voucher: lines of employee, attendance type and value (`ATTENDANCEENTRIES.LIST`). Payroll voucher: lines of employee,
pay head and amount; the backend adds the ledger lines (each pay head ledger debited for earnings or credited for deductions,
the payable ledger chosen as party taking the net) and sends `CATEGORYENTRY.LIST` > `EMPLOYEEENTRIES.LIST` >
`PAYHEADALLOCATIONS.LIST` with the ledger lines in the PaySlip view. Both are imported from Tally too (the one Attendance and
the one Payroll voucher already in Tally came in with their lines). Form: an Attendance view and a Payroll view.

Live (entries `App: Create Attendance ...` onwards): Attendance 26 days, edited to 24 with a date move (sent twice at once: one
voucher), cancelled, deleted. Payroll Basic 5000 + TA 1000: Tally stored the pay heads and `Basic Salary Dr 5000, TA Dr 1000,
Salary Payable Cr 6000`; edited to Basic 5500 + DA 700; cancelled; deleted. A Payroll for an employee Tally does not have: 400
with `Cost Centre 'Nobody Here' does not exist!`, nothing kept.

Found on the way: Tally uses the payroll lists for the cost centre allocations of ordinary vouchers as well, so the first import
stored five such allocations as pay head lines. Only Payroll vouchers are read that way now; the five rows were removed.

### Not covered

- Deductions (PF and the like): written by symmetry with earnings and covered by a test against the fake Tally, but this company
  has no deduction pay head, so not run live.
- Creating or editing employees, attendance types and pay heads from the app: they are read from Tally only.
- The existing Attendance and Payroll vouchers in Tally were imported but not edited (they are real data).
- The three new form views were opened in the browser and render; saving through them was not clicked through (the same
  requests were made against the API).
- Salary calculation (deriving amounts from attendance and salary structures) is not part of this: amounts are entered.

Tests: backend 182 passed, agent 17 passed. No test voucher, item or login is left; app and Tally match by count.

## Step 10 — Voucher Configuration (F12) screen: can it sync with Tally? (2026-10-10)

**First attempt:** pre-flight health check timed out (Tally down); nothing was sent. Resumed after restart.

| Operation | Request | Response | Verification | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Read every field of all voucher types (read only) | Collection `AuditVchTypeAll`, `TYPE VoucherType`, `FETCH *` | Attendance 88 fields, Sales 68, Payment 68 | None of the app's 34 Voucher Configuration switches (Cr/Dr vs To/By, supplier ref, negative cash/stock warnings, bill-wise prompts, cheque, e-way bill prompts…) is among them. Fields present are voucher type master settings only: numbering, `COMMONNARRATION`, `MULTINARRATION`, `PRINTAFTERSAVE`, `ISOPTIONAL`, `PREVENTDUPLICATES`, `USEFORPOSINVOICE`, etc. | ✅ |
| Health check | — | Tally up, Bhrama Enterprises | — | ✅ |

**Conclusion:** Tally's F12 entry settings are not part of company data, so they cannot be read or written over the XML interface. In the app, 33 of the 34 switches are stored and never read; `use_cr_dr` only changes Dr/Cr vs By/To labels on the accounting form. No app or Tally data was changed.

**Side observation:** voucher type Attendance holds `PREVNARRATION = "ZZ H attendance edited"`, Sales `"ZZ R sales"`, Payment `"ZZ R payment"` — Tally's memory of the last narration typed, left by earlier test vouchers. The vouchers themselves were deleted; it changes no voucher and is replaced the next time a voucher of that type is saved.

### Step 10 follow-up — Voucher Configuration made app-only and wired up (2026-10-10)

No Tally request was needed. Changes:

- The screen now shows only the six settings the app acts on, and only for voucher types they apply to; Attendance, Payroll,
  Physical Stock and Stock Journal have none and no Configuration button. It states that nothing goes to Tally.
- Saving the screen used to queue and send a full Voucher Type `Alter` to Tally (numbering, narration and print settings from
  the app's copy) although none of the switches are in it. It now sends nothing.
- Working settings: Cr/Dr vs To/By labels; ledger balance beside ledger names; warning when a cash ledger would go below
  zero; supplier invoice no. and date on purchase types; warning when quantity exceeds stock on Sales, Delivery Note and
  Debit Note; voucher number as bill reference on Sales.
- Bill reference: a new Sales voucher's bill is named after the voucher number (after the reference number when the setting
  is off and a reference is given). An edited voucher keeps the bill name it has. The push to Tally now sends the name of
  the stored bill, so app and Tally hold the bill under one name.

Checked: backend 184 passed (two new cases for bill naming against the fake Tally); `tsc --noEmit` clean; in the browser the
balances, both warnings, the purchase fields and the reduced screen were seen, and saving the screen returned 200.
Not run against live Tally: the bill-name change (covered by the fake Tally only).

## Step 11 — Masters on Tally's Alter list: what the app covers and what Tally's API accepts (2026-10-10)

- A collection request with `<TYPE>Scenario</TYPE>` made Tally show "Internal Error. Incorrect Object Type!" in a dialog that
  blocked it until OK was clicked (reported as a halt). Guessed collection types are not used any more; the standard
  `List of Accounts` / `All Masters` export is used to see what exists.
- That export returned: Currency, Unit, CostCategory, StockCategory, AttendanceType, Group, TaxUnit (GST registrations),
  Ledger, StockGroup, CostCentre, Godown, StockItem, VoucherType (plus income-tax tables). No Budget, Scenario,
  GST Classification or Cost Centre Class objects exist in this company, so their shape is unknown.
- Payroll masters, written and removed as `ZZ P ...` test records (entries `Step 11 - Create ...` above): Employee Category
  (a Cost Category), Employee Group (Cost Centre with `ISEMPLOYEEGROUP`/`FORPAYROLL`), Unit (Work) (an ordinary Unit;
  `FORPAYROLL` is not kept on it), Attendance and Production Type, Pay Head earning and deduction (Ledger with `PAYTYPE`),
  Employee with salary details (`EMPLOYEEPERIOD.LIST` > `EMPLOYEERATE.LIST`): all created, read back, altered (employee,
  attendance type) and deleted. Counts afterwards unchanged: 53 ledgers, 5 units, 5 cost centres.
- Seen in the export, not caused by this step: Tally holds two currencies, `?` (GUID ...1d, the one ledgers use) and `₹`
  (GUID ...11d).
